chunks: And Abū Baṣīr said: I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh (peace be upon him) say:

When Ruqayyah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), died, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) stood by her grave, raised his hand towards the sky, and his eyes shed tears. They said: 'O Messenger of Allah, we have seen you raise your head to the sky and your eyes shed tears.' He said: 'I asked my Lord to grant me Ruqayyah from the squeezing of the grave.'
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet ask for when standing by Ruqayyah's grave?
ai.summary: This narration from *Kitab al-Zuhd* highlights the Prophet’s intimate intercession for his daughter Ruqayyah, specifically requesting relief from *dahr al-qabr* (the constriction or squeezing of the grave), a concept central to Shia eschatology regarding the Barzakh. It underscores the belief that even the Prophet’s loved ones are subject to the trials of the grave, yet can be granted mercy through divine supplication, reinforcing the spiritual significance of the grave as a transitional realm.
